items.name: White
items.role: the universal primary CTA pill background. "Download" / "Install Extension" / "Get Pro" — every primary action carries it.

items.name: White Pressed
items.role: pressed-state for the primary pill — a single notch dimmer.

items.name: On Primary
items.role: pure black text on the white CTA — the only place black appears as text in the system.

items.name: Canvas
items.role: pure-near-black page background. The dominant surface across every page.

items.name: Surface
items.role: card and elevated panel background — one notch lighter than canvas.

items.name: Surface Elevated
items.role: button-tertiary fill, text-input fill, store-search-bar fill, pill-tab-active fill.

items.name: Surface Card
items.role: app-icon-tile background, keycap fill, command-palette row hover.

items.name: Button FG (in-card)
items.role: rare deep-card variant used inside featured pricing tier card backgrounds.

items.name: Hairline
items.role: the universal 1px card border. Carries every card edge across every page.

items.name: Hairline Soft
items.role: ): even fainter border on translucent over-image overlays.

items.name: Hairline Strong
items.role: ): stronger 1px divider where a regular hairline reads as too soft.

items.name: Ink
items.role: primary headlines on dark canvas. Slightly off-white for tonal coherence with the near-black background.

items.name: Body
items.role: default paragraph text and inline-link color.

items.name: Charcoal
items.role: subtly brighter body where ink reads too soft.

items.name: Mute
items.role: metadata, footer link text, secondary captions.

items.name: Ash
items.role: disabled-state text, lowest-emphasis utility.

items.name: Stone
items.role: least-emphasis caption text and disabled icon color.

items.name: On Dark
items.role: interactive-state primary text (button label, focused tab).

items.name: On Dark Mute
items.role: ): translucent secondary text on dark surfaces.

items.name: Accent Blue
items.role: + Soft (rgba(87,193,255,0.15)): info and informational badge — used inside feature illustrations and the rare "New" pill.

items.name: Accent Red
items.role: + Soft (rgba(255,97,97,0.15)): destructive/error indicator + Slack/Apple category accent in extension illustrations.

items.name: Accent Green
items.role: + Soft (rgba(89,212,153,0.15)): success state + productivity category accent in extension illustrations.

items.name: Accent Yellow
items.role: + Soft (rgba(255,197,51,0.15)): "warning" semantic + the Hacker News orange-yellow that appears as the most prominent accent illustration on the home page hero.
